providers.name: OpenAI
providers.tagline: GPT Image. Great for final images, edits and transparent PNGs.

steps.text: Sign in to the OpenAI Platform, or create a free account.
Add a payment method or credits under Billing. Images need a paid account.
Create a new secret key, name it ImageGenKit, and copy it.

providers.name: Grok subscription
providers.tagline: Uses your grok.com subscription. No per-image cost. Great for quick drafts.

steps.text: Install Grok Build, xAI's free command line app.
Log in with the account that has your Grok subscription.

providers.name: xAI API
providers.tagline: Grok Imagine with an API key. Pay per image, no subscription needed.

steps.text: Sign in to the xAI Console, or create an account.
Create an API key and copy it.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.tagline: Nano Banana image models from Google.

steps.text: Sign in to Google AI Studio with your Google account.
Create an API key and copy it.
Turn on billing for the key's Google Cloud project. Image models need a paid tier.
